name: World History Map
description: An interactive atlas of shifting political borders, states, and empires from 3400 BCE to 2024 CE.
overview: Explore 5,400 years of shifting empires, borders, and civilizations on a fluid 3D globe or flat historical atlas.

features.title: 3D Globe & 2D Atlas
features.copy: Morph smoothly between a spherical Earth in space with atmospheric glow and a flat Mercator map, with drag, tilt, and compass reset.

features.title: 5,400-Year Timeline
features.copy: Scrub the year slider, step by 1, 10, or 100 years, type any year directly, or press play to watch borders evolve automatically.

features.title: Thematic Color Lenses
features.copy: Recolor the world by distinct states, religion, political system, economy, or labor system—with custom color pickers and multi-select legend filters.

features.title: Switchable Base Layers
features.copy: Cycle between modern Positron cartography, orbital satellite imagery, or clean natural terrain with zero modern borders.

features.title: State & Empire Profiles
features.copy: Click any territory or search the active-states sidebar to view its lifespan, governance, religion, economy, capital, population estimate, area, and Wikipedia link.

features.title: Works Anywhere
features.copy: Runs directly in the browser on desktop or mobile and installs to your home screen as a fullscreen web app.

credit: Border data from Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank, v0.2.1) with OpenFreeMap basemaps.
